title: About Adept
llmNone: No language model is used in this version. When one is added, its name and purpose will be listed here.
methodBody: Trend signals feed role outlooks under two scenarios; matches combine skill overlap, trend outlook and interest fit; pathways use a course catalogue with verified dates.
limitsBody: All predictions are estimates. Demo data is synthetic. Adept supports human decisions and never makes hiring decisions.
